Rich Text: text size, lead paragraph and colour

The Style tab's Text size, First paragraph and Text colour of the Rich Text block, on the Section backgrounds. Each example is labelled with its variation; select it in Universal Editor to see the values in its dialog.

Text size Small

text

Tata Consultancy Services helps enterprises reimagine how they work, with technology, consulting and business solutions delivered across more than fifty countries.

Our teams combine deep industry knowledge with platforms, partners and research, so that every transformation starts from the outcomes that matter to the business.

From cloud foundations to AI at scale, we build resilient operations, connected experiences and new sources of growth, and we measure progress together with our clients.
